title: December 2025
description: The agentic coding paper studying the AI engineering workflows of experienced developers is out on arXiv! Take a read here and let me know what you think. Discussion, feedback, and thoughts for future projects are welcome!

title: August 2025
description: Graduated from TDP and continued to work in Cyber D&M! Still working on adding features to our self-service platform, but I'm taking on some work in Cyber Threat Detection building heatmap visualizations.

title: October 2024
description: Started my second TDP rotation at Capital One staying within Cyber, but working in detection and mitigation instead of identity and access management. I'll be developing the team's self service platform.

title: March 2024
description: The second project I was on at the CEAL Lab, Help Supporters, was accepted to CHI '24! We explored the design space of assistive technologies to support face-to-face help between blind and sighted strangers.

title: February 2024
description: Graduated from CODA and started my first TDP rotation within Cyber! I'll be building authorization plugins and other full stack features for the company's access portal, along with some design systems on the side.

title: August 2023
description: Got accepted to ASSETS '23 with the work I did at Brian Smith's CEAL Lab! Read the paper in October. I also joined Capital One after graduating, training to become a Software Engineer in six months.

title: March 2023
description: My second article was accepted for publication in The Loop! Within it, I discuss the already present threats AI causes society, but even through these hardships, these technologies can be used for good.

title: October 2022
description: My article discussing the limits of quantititve social science was accepted into The Loop! The piece examines interdisciplinary research methods and how well it captures the complexity of human dynamics.

title: June 2022
description: Excited to announce that I'll be spending the summer in New York as part of the XR Access REU! I'll be working with the CEAL Lab under Brian Smith's mentorship building assistive technologies prototypes.

title: November 2021
description: Co-hosted another talk for Knight Hacks on how to contribute to open source projects and why it's an underrated way to get practical software engineering experience on your resumé!

title: September 2021
description: Thank you to Knight Hacks for letting me co-host a talk about how to get into the tech industry through research opportunities and how to leverage your background effectively, regardless of what you're studying.

title: June 2021
description: Thrilled to join the University of Washington Tacoma as part of the Spatial Models and Electoral Distrciting REU! I'll be working with Jim and Courtney Thatcher on finding new ways to identify communities of interest.

title: May 2021
description: My article with the Council on Foreign Relations covering COVID-19 vaccinations efforts is now live! Huge shoutout to Lindsay Mainland and Will Merrow for help with research and data visualizations.
